# CodeItAll

> Free interactive coding education in the browser: Python, C++, JavaScript, HTML, and SQL labs—plus Career Booster portfolio practice and Website Dissect for learning how real pages are built.

## Site
- Home: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/
- Learn with AI (courses): https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/course/
- Python Lab: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/lab/
- C++ Lab: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/cpp/lab/
- JavaScript Lab: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/js/lab/
- HTML Lab: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/html/lab/
- SQL Lab: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/sql/lab/
- Career Booster: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/career/
- Dissect any website: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/dissect/
- Project notebooks: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/notebooks/
- Account / progress: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/profile/
- About: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/about.html
- Contact: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/contact.html
- Sitemap: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- robots.txt: https://codeitall-site.vercel.app/robots.txt

## Audience
Beginners, students, and career switchers who want free hands-on coding practice without installing an IDE.

## Primary topics
learn to code free online, interactive coding labs, Python/JavaScript/SQL/HTML/C++ practice in browser, portfolio coding projects, how websites are built
